title: Internet Kaise Kaam Karta Hai: DNS, IP aur HTTP Aasan Bhasha Me
description: Internet kaise kaam karta hai — IP address, DNS lookup, HTTP request aur packet switching, ek page load ke poore safar ke saath, aasan Hinglish me samjhein.
hero_caption: Internet ek jaadu nahi — cables, routers aur chhote packets ka ek bahut bada network hai
